name: Vehicle Registration (RC)
department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways — Parivahan
summary: Register a new or transferred motor vehicle and obtain a Registration Certificate (RC) through the state RTO via the Vahan portal.
eligibility: Owner of a motor vehicle purchased in India or imported and cleared through customs
Vehicle must have valid insurance and have cleared applicable road tax
documents: Sale certificate (Form 21) and roadworthiness certificate (Form 22) from the dealer
Proof of address and identity of the owner
Road tax payment receipt and PUC (Pollution Under Control) certificate
fee: Varies by vehicle category and state; typically includes a registration fee, road tax (state-specific, often a percentage of ex-showroom price), and a smart-card fee. Check the Vahan portal for state-wise fee schedules.
process: Dealer typically initiates temporary registration and forwards documents to the RTO
Verify details and pay applicable road tax and fees via the Vahan portal
RTO inspects and approves the application
Permanent Registration Certificate (RC) is issued, valid for 15 years (renewable) for private vehicles
Track and download RC status online

faq.question: How long is a vehicle registration valid?
faq.answer: For private (non-transport) vehicles, the RC is valid for 15 years and can be renewed. Commercial vehicles have shorter validity periods set by the RTO.

faq.question: Can I register a vehicle without a dealer?
faq.answer: For a used or imported vehicle, or a vehicle bought outside the standard dealer process, you can apply directly at the RTO using Form 20 and the required supporting documents.
